THESE ARE MOCKUP FRAMES AT 390px. THEY ARE NOT THE LIVE APP. AND THIS PAGE CHANGES NOTHING.

  • Read-only. This is an audit. No production code, copy, i18n key or identifier was touched to build it, and nothing here proposes a replacement word. Every Marathi character on this page is a string that already exists in the branch — none of it was written for this page.
  • The frames are assembled, not screenshotted. The visual language — frame, cards, chips, cells, buttons, colours — is the one in _TOKENS.md and the 2026-09-01 mockups. The content is the audited strings from the real components. Those two do not match each other: only 56 of the 278 audited strings appear anywhere in the mockup HTML, because the mockups draw a proposed design and this audit reads the shipped one. So treat every frame as a faithful inventory of what a screen says, laid out by element role — not as a picture of what it looks like. Positions inside a frame are indicative; the strings, verdicts and file lines are the evidence.
  • Reachability is stated per string and is load-bearing: 222 live, 18 preview-only, 38 unreachable today. Eleven of the 37 FAILs are written but never rendered for a farmer.

Labour V2 · Release 1 · spec 2026-08-28-labour-v2-release-1 · branch feat/labour-v2-r1 @ 0a9569ea · 2026-09-04

Marathi screen audit

Where the farmer meets each word, and whether it passes the Marathi gate. One row per string per screen — a string used on three screens is three rows, which is the entire point. The flat audit (farmer-facing-vocabulary-audit.md, 453 strings / 259 terms / N1–N15) answered which words exist. It has no screen dimension and no doctrine verdict. This page adds both and does not repeat its term list.

Verdict discipline — read this before you read a single row

FAIL only for a CANON rule (tone guide, banned list, spelling, MDR-002). FLAG for anything resting on MDR-021 (Proposed), on the founder's 2026-09-03 vocabulary rule, or on judgement. PASS rows are included so the whole picture is visible, not only the problems.

Dim

How to use this

Every farmer-visible string carries a number, the same number the JSON uses (1–278), so it is quotable. Click any number — in the frame or in the list — and its twin lights up on the other side. Marker colour is the verdict: PASS neutral, FLAG amber, FAIL rose. Toasts, errors and screen-reader-only labels cannot sit in a frame, so they are chips below it with their trigger stated.

One screen at a time, deliberately. All 23 rendered together make a page ~59,000px tall, and browsers stop painting past about 32,767px — the bottom third would silently go blank. Pick a screen below; the address bar keeps your place.

श्रम साथी
तुम्ही शेतात केलेली कामे आणि तुमची शेती करण्याची कार्यपद्धत समजून घेत आहे
जे मोजता येतं, त्याचं नियोजन करता येतं — आणि आज तुम्ही शेतकाम मोजायला सुरुवात केली.
दिवसभराच्या कामातून दिलेला एक मिनिट, शेतातलं प्रत्येक काम सांभाळण्याच्या दिशेने तुमचं पहिलं पाऊल आहे.
आतापासून तुमची शेती अंदाजावर नाही, तुमच्या पूर्वीच्या निर्णयांवर उभी राहील.
जे नोंद ठेवत नाहीत त्यांच्यासाठी असतो अंदाज; जे ठेवतात त्यांच्यासाठी असते नियोजनबद्ध दिशा.
आज तुम्ही फक्त पीक घेत नाही — स्वतःचं आणि तुमच्या शेतजमिनीच्या ज्ञानाचा पाया रोवत आहात.
प्रगतशील शेतकरी शंकेवर नाही, स्वतःच्या नोंदींवरून निर्णय घेतो.
आज केलेली प्रत्येक नोंद, उद्याचा निर्णय सोपा करते.
तुम्ही मोजायला लागता, त्याच क्षणी नशीब तुमच्या शेतीवर राज्य करणं थांबवतं.
नोंदवलेलं शहाणपण पुढच्या पिढीला कामी येतं; विसरलेली चूक पुन्हा तीच चूक करायला भाग पाडते.
आज तुम्ही ‘असेल कदाचित’ वरून ‘मला माहीत आहे’ पर्यंत पोहोचलात.
आकड्यांवर चालणारी शेती, हीच खऱ्या अर्थाने तुमच्या हातातली शेती.
इतिहास त्यांनाच मार्ग दाखवतो जे तो लिहितात — आज तुम्ही तुमचा लिहिताय.
हंगामाचा अंदाज बांधण्यापासून त्याचं नियोजन करण्यापर्यंत — हाच खरा बदल आहे.
आज तुम्ही फक्त शेतकरी नाही — स्वतःची शेती पुढे नेणारे प्रगतशील आणि नियोजनबद्ध शेतकरी आहात.
आजचं छोटं मोजमाप, उद्या तुमच्या शेतीवरचं पूर्ण नियंत्रण देतं.

The register check

-चं vs -चे

MDR-021 names this as “a shipping defect, not a style note: the register is split between spoken (-चं) and written (-चे) forms. One person cannot be both.” MDR-021 · proposed, not canon It is real in this data, and the screen dimension shows where the seam runs.

spoken · -चं

86

the house style

written · -चे

25

the exception — which is what makes each one stand out rather than blend in

n/a

167

carries no inflection to judge

Register by voice layer — the finding

voice layerspokenwrittenn/a
sathi26811
chrome276141
ambiguous331115

The split is not a chrome-versus-character split — both layers do both. That is exactly MDR-021’s complaint, and it means the defect cannot be fixed by deciding “chrome writes, Sathi speaks”.

Where the seam is sharpest

Inside one file, four lines apart — i18n/syncTranslations.ts

लक्षात ठेवलं ✓ (spoken, live on four surfaces) · श्रम साथी ने समजले व लक्षात ठेवले (written, no surface) · श्रम सफल मध्ये साठवून ठेवले (written, no surface). Same claim, two registers. Both long forms also detach the postposition — Hindi word-shape, not Marathi. A flat list shows three strings of equal weight; the screen dimension shows one shipping and two waiting.

A live one, on the log page — labourOversightTranslations.ts

कामे सांगण्यासाठी तयार uses the written plural कामे while every sibling string on the same card is spoken (काम / कामं / कामाच्या). Same file, same card, two registers. निवडले is the same shape.

The doctrine column, stated once

Every FLAG and FAIL row on this page names the rule that produced it, in its own Doctrine line. This is the key to those lines. The split between the two boxes is the only thing that decides FAIL versus FLAG.

Canon — a breach here is a FAIL

  • MARATHI_TONE_GUIDE.md — banned words: AI · डिजिटल · सॉफ्टवेअर · प्लॅटफॉर्म · प्रॉडक्टिव्हिटी · स्मार्ट · ॅप · क्रांतिकारी · पॉवरफुल
  • Avoid — over-Sanskritized तत्सम (प्रणाली · मूल्यमापन · अभिलेख); urban-corporate English-in-Devanagari; childish; translated-English structure; an English loan where a clean Marathi word exists (record→नोंद, proof→पुरावा, work→काम).
  • Never insult — the pride section bans “शेतकरी नोंदी ठेवत नाहीत म्हणून नुकसान”.
  • Spelling — Mukadam is मुकादम, never मुखादम. This tree is clean.
  • MDR-002 (Accepted) — Marathi-first. It considered and REJECTED bilingual-everything as clutter for a low-literacy reader.
  • copy-chief checklist — “Claim (if any) is backed by proof.”

MDR-021 — PROPOSED, NOT CANON — a breach here is only a FLAG

  • Three layers. Outside voice (marketing) → नोंद canonical. Inside voice (anything श्रम साथी says to the farmer, as a person) → नोंद/नोंदी banned, समजून घेणे instead. UI chrome (buttons, stat names, headings, system notices) → नोंद permitted.
  • Its own named risk: “UI chrome is the soft edge.” This audit measures that edge at 59 ambiguous of 278 — more than one string in five has no settled speaker.
  • Its named shipping defect: the register is split between spoken (-चं) and written (-चे) forms. “One person cannot be both.”
  • Nothing on a violet row is settled law. It is flagged so you can rule on it — not so you can act on it as if you already had.

The decision bridge

N1–N15, tied to the screens the words are actually on

The fifteen naming decisions come from farmer-facing-vocabulary-audit.md §E and are restated here unchanged — no option is proposed there and none is proposed here. What this page adds is the right-hand half: for each decision, the screens where its words really appear, how many of those strings are live, and the strings themselves. So the naming session works from screens rather than from a word list.

Screen matching is by substring against the 278 audited strings. It is a bridge, not a census — the flat audit covers 453 strings and reaches files this screen walk does not enumerate (DetailSheet.tsx, ReliabilityScoreCard.tsx, IdentitySection.tsx). A decision showing few hits here still owns everything the flat audit lists for it.

N1

What is this subsystem called to a farmer?

The rule bans both “Labour” and a person-classifying noun on farmer surfaces. Note what the screen walk adds: कामगार व्यवस्थापन was replaced on 2026-09-03 at all five sites; the door, the hub title and the log banner now agree on कामाच्या नोंदी.
